speech.heard: Eswatini gets 35.5% of government revenue from trade taxes. The USA gets 1.6%. Eswatini is the world's highest, relying on border customs for over a third of its public funds. The USA relies far less on border customs, taking in just 1.6% of its revenue there. Side by side, Eswatini depends on trade taxes 22 times as much as the USA. Across the globe, the median country collects 4.4% of total revenue from trade taxes. Bosnia is the world's lowest, drawing just 0.00001% of its revenue from border taxes. How much does your country depend on international trade taxes?
